subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu group chat: slash commands like /new, /status, and /model do not work and may lose message content

question: Should Feishu slash commands with no explicit command allowlist inherit already-admitted Feishu sender access, or should the shared command-gating helper change globally for every channel?
rationale: Both approaches can fix the observed Feishu failure, but the shared-helper approach changes the control-command authorization boundary across channel runtimes and has already been treated as security-sensitive in related PR review.

options.title: Prefer Feishu-Scoped Inheritance
options.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial.

options.title: Approve Shared Helper Change
options.body: Change `resolveCommandAuthorizedFromAuthorizers` globally so an all-unconfigured command-authorizer set is allowed under access groups, with cross-channel security and upgrade tests.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed Default
options.body: Require explicit command allowlists for Feishu control commands and document or repair the operator setup path instead of changing runtime defaults.

recommendation.title: Prefer Feishu-Scoped Inheritance
recommendation.body: Authorize Feishu text commands for senders already admitted by Feishu DM/group policy when no Feishu command allowlist is configured, while preserving explicit allowlist denial.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision sits on the shared command-gating/security boundary where the strongest feature history points to steipete.
